title: 댐건설ㆍ관리 및 주변지역지원 등에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment ( Water Resources Development Division ), 044-201-7685

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「댐건설ㆍ관리 및 주변지역지원 등에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2022. 6. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Construction and Management of Dams and Support for Surrounding Areas, etc. and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof. <Amended June 15, 2022>
[Wholly Amended Nov. 30, 2011]
Article 2 Deleted <June 7, 2006>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(경고표지의 설치) 「댐건설ㆍ관리 및 주변지역지원 등에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제7조제2항에 따른 경고 표지는 별표 1에 따라 설치한다. 다만, 방류일시, 하천 및 그 부근의 상황 등을 고려하여 특히 필요하다고 인정할 때에는 별표 2에 따라 설치한다. <개정 2022. 6. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Installation of Warning Signs) Warning signs pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Construction and Management of Dams and Support for Surrounding Areas, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be installed in accordance with Annex 1. However, when deemed particularly necessary in consideration of the time of discharge, the conditions of the river and its vicinity, etc., they shall be installed in accordance with Annex 2. <Amended June 15, 2022>

[Wholly Amended Nov. 30, 2011]
[Moved from Article 6 <June 15, 2022>]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(토지 출입 등을 위한 신분을 표시하는 증표) 「댐건설ㆍ관리 및 주변지역지원 등에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제14조제9항에 따른 토지 출입 등을 위한 신분을 표시하는 증표는 별지 제1호서식에 따른다. <개정 2022. 6. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Identification Card for Entry into Land, etc.) The identification card for entry into land, etc., pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 9 of the Act on the Construction and Management of Dams and Support for Surrounding Areas, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 attached hereto . <Amended June 15, 2022>
[Wholly Amended Nov. 30, 2011]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(댐 준공인가 신청서 등) ① 영 제15조제1항에 따른 댐 준공인가 신청서는 별지 제2호서식에 따른다. <개정 2022. 6. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Application for Approval of Dam Completion, etc.) ① The application for approval of dam completion pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Attached Form No. 2 . <Amended June 15, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제15조제1항에 따른 댐 준공인가 신청서에는 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부해야 한다. <개정 2022. 6. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② The application for approval of dam completion pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be accompanied by the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 15, 2022>
1. Completion Report (including completion design documents and completion photographs)

rows.source_ko: 2. 건설비용 및 그 부담에 관한 사항을 적은 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents specifying matters regarding construction costs and their burden
3. Land Survey

rows.source_ko: 4. 시장(특별자치시의 경우에는 특별자치시장을 말하고, 특별자치도의 경우에는 특별자치도지사를 말한다)ㆍ군수 또는 구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다)이 발행하는 지적측량성과도[수몰지의 경우에는 수몰용지도(水沒用地圖)]
rows.text_en: 4. Cadastral survey results map issued by the Mayor (in the case of a Special Self-Governing City, the Mayor of the Special Self-Governing City; in the case of a Special Self-Governing Province, the Governor of the Special Self-Governing Province), the County Governor, or the District Head (referring to the District Head of an autonomous district) [in the case of flooded land, the flooded land map]

rows.source_ko: 5. 공공시설물 및 토지 등의 귀속에 관한 사항을 적은 서류 및 도면
rows.text_en: 5. Documents and drawings containing matters concerning the attribution of public facilities and land, etc.
6. Management and Disposition Plan for Land and Facilities, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 준공인가에 필요한 사항을 적은 서류
rows.text_en: 7. Other documents containing matters necessary for the completion approval

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제15조제2항에 따른 댐 준공인가 증명서는 별지 제3호서식에 따른다. <개정 2022. 6. 15.>
rows.text_en: ③ The certificate of approval for the completion of a dam pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Attached Form . <Amended June 15, 2022>
[Wholly Amended Nov. 30, 2011]

rows.source_ko: 제5조의2(댐건설 완료의 고시 전 댐의 사용 승인신청서 등) ① 영 제16조제1항에 따른 댐건설 완료의 고시 전 사용 승인신청서는 별지 제3호의2서식에 따른다. <개정 2022. 6. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 5-2 (Application for Approval of Dam Use Prior to Public Notice of Completion of Dam Construction, etc.) ① The application for approval of use prior to the public notice of completion of dam construction pursuant to Article 16 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Attached Form No. 3-2 . <Amended June 15, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제16조제2항에 따른 댐건설 완료의 고시 전 사용 승인증명서는 별지 제3호의3서식에 따른다. <개정 2022. 6. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② The certificate of approval for use prior to the public notice of completion of dam construction pursuant to Article 16 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 3-3 of the Attached Form . <Amended June 15, 2022>
[This Article Newly Inserted June 2, 2017]
Article 6
[Former Article 6 moved to Article 3 <June 15, 2022>]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(대체건설비 및 타당투자액의 산출방법) 영 제20조에 따라 댐사용권설정예정자의 다목적댐건설비용 부담금액을 산출함에 있어서 대체건설비 및 타당투자액의 세부적인 산출방법은 별표 3과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Calculation Method for Replacement Construction Costs and Feasible Investment Amount) In calculating the amount of multi-purpose dam construction costs to be borne by the prospective holder of dam usage rights pursuant to Article 20 of the Enforcement Decree, the detailed calculation method for replacement construction costs and feasible investment amounts is as set forth in Attached Table 3 .
[Wholly Amended Nov. 30, 2011]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(부담금의 반환이자) 영 제21조제3항에 따른 부담금의 반환이자는 연 8퍼센트의 이자율을 적용하여 산정한다. 다만, 부담금의 납부일부터 반환일까지의 기간(이하 이 조에서 “반환기간”이라 한다)이 1년 미만인 경우에는 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 이자율을 적용하여 산정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Interest on Return of Levy) The interest on the return of a levy pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be calculated by applying an annual interest rate of 8 percent. However, if the period from the date of payment of the levy to the date of return (hereinafter referred to as the “return period”) in this Article is less than one year, the interest shall be calculated by applying the interest rate according to the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.
1. If the return period is less than 1 month: 0 percent per annum
2. If the return period is 1 month or more but less than 3 months: 5 percent per annum
3. If the return period is 3 months or more but less than 6 months: 6 percent per annum
4. If the return period is 6 months or more but less than 1 year: 7 percent per annum
[Wholly Amended Nov. 30, 2011]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(수익자부담금의 산출방법) 영 제24조제2항에 따라 수익자부담금을 계산할 때 다목적댐의 건설로 인하여 증가되는 각 발전사업자의 예상 수익은 별표 3 제2호를 준용하여 산출한다. 이 경우 별표 3 제2호 중 “타당투자액”은 “예상 수익”으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Method of Calculating Beneficiary Contributions) When calculating beneficiary contributions pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the expected revenue of each power generation business operator increased due to the construction of a multi-purpose dam shall be calculated by applying Subparagraph 2 of Annex 3 mutatis mutandis. In this case, “feasible investment amount” in Subparagraph 2 of Annex 3 shall be deemed as “expected revenue.”
[Wholly Amended Nov. 30, 2011]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(댐사용권의 설정신청 등) 법 제24조제1항에 따라 댐사용권을 설정받으려 하거나, 같은 조 제5항에 따른 다목적댐의 저수 사용허가를 받으려는 자는 별지 제4호서식의 신청서에 저수사용계획서를 첨부하여 기후에너지환경부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2018. 6. 8., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Application for Establishment of Dam Use Rights, etc.) Any person who intends to obtain the establishment of dam use rights pursuant to Article 24 , Paragraph 1 of the Act , or to obtain a permit for the use of reservoir water of a multi-purpose dam pursuant to Paragraph 5 of the same Article , shall submit an application in the form of Annex 4, attached with a reservoir use plan, to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Jun. 8, 2018; Oct. 1, 2025>
[Wholly Amended Nov. 30, 2011]
Article 11 Deleted <Aug. 13, 2002>

rows.source_ko: 제12조(점용료 또는 사용료의 징수절차 등) ① 영 제47조에 따라 댐수탁관리자가 점용료 또는 사용료를 부과ㆍ징수하려는 경우에는 납부자에게 납부기한 및 납부금액 등을 적은 납부고지서를 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Procedures for Collection of Occupancy Fees or Usage Fees, etc.) ① In cases where a dam trustee intends to impose or collect occupancy fees or usage fees pursuant to Article 47 of the Enforcement Decree , he/she shall issue a notice of payment to the payer specifying the payment deadline and the amount to be paid, etc.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 점용료 또는 사용료를 부과할 때 점용 또는 사용 기간이 1년 미만인 경우에는 허가를 할 때에 점용료 또는 사용료의 전액을 부과하고, 점용기간이 1년 이상인 경우에는 매 회계연도 단위로 부과하되, 해당 연도분은 허가를 할 때에, 그 후의 연도분은 매년도 시작 후 3개월 이내에 부과한다. 다만, 토석ㆍ모래ㆍ자갈 등 하천 산출물의 채취기간이 6개월 이상이거나 그 밖의 특별한 사유가 있는 경우에는 댐수탁관리자가 정하는 바에 따라 분할하여 부과ㆍ징수할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② When imposing occupancy fees or usage fees pursuant to Paragraph 1, if the period of occupancy or use is less than one year, the full amount of the occupancy fee or usage fee shall be imposed at the time of granting the permit; if the period of occupancy is one year or more, the fee shall be imposed on a fiscal year basis, with the fee for the relevant year being imposed at the time of granting the permit and the fee for subsequent years being imposed within three months of the start of each year. However, if the period of extraction of river products such as soil, sand, and gravel is six months or more, or if there are other special circumstances, the fee may be imposed and collected in installments as determined by the dam trustee.
[Wholly Amended Nov. 30, 2011]
Article 13 Deleted <April 17, 2023>
ADDENDA <Ministry of Construction and Transportation Decree No. 233, Mar. 29, 2000>

ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 988, June 15, 2022>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on June 16, 2022.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(다른 법령과의 관계) 이 규칙 시행 당시 다른 법령에서 종전의 「댐건설 및 주변지역지원 등에 관한 법률 시행규칙」이나 그 규정을 인용한 경우 이 규칙 중 그에 해당하는 규정이 있는 때에는 이 규칙이나 이 규칙의 해당 규정을 인용한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Relationship with Other Laws and Regulations)  Where, at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, other laws and regulations refer to the former "Enforcement Rules of the Act on Dam Construction and Support for Surrounding Areas, etc." or its provisions, and there are corresponding provisions in this Rule, it shall be deemed that this Rule or the relevant provisions of this Rule have been referred to.

rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 1032, Apr. 17, 2023> (Ministry of Environment Decree on the Partial Amendment of 17 Laws for the Reorganization of Regulatory Review Periods)
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <기후에너지환경부령 제1호, 2025. 10. 1.> (기후에너지환경부와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment Decree No. 1, Oct. 1, 2025> (Enforcement Rule on the Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 부칙 제6조에 따라 개정되는 부령 중 이 규칙 시행 전에 공포되었으나 시행일이 도래하지 아니한 부령을 개정한 부분은 각각 해당 부령의 시행일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, among the Ministerial Ordinances amended pursuant to Article 6 of the Addenda, the parts amending Ministerial Ordinances that were promulgated prior to the enforcement of this Rule but whose effective date has not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective effective dates of those Ordinances.
Articles 2  through 5 omitted
